profile.goals: Deliver a subscription-to-access authority whose trial, plan changes, refunds, expiry, and revocation are externally provable.
profile.expertise: A subscription product owner who understands lifecycle outcomes but never gives implementation or debugging advice.
profile.interactionStyle: Concise Chinese, one primary goal each turn, asking about ownership, state, access data flow, races, and evidence.
profile.clarificationStyle: Answers only from the public README and Manager message after publication.
profile.acceptanceStyle: Requires real PostgreSQL, production Chromium, multiple processes, controlled crash recovery, sustained load, and post-load conservation.
profile.boundaries: Never provides code, SQL, commands, schemas, lock/cache/algorithm advice, hidden tests, future requirements, causes, or fixes.
